एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'SPIN' को 18-15-10-13 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है और 'BUCKET' को 1-22-2-10-6-19 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। समान भाषा में 'WEATHER' को किस प्रकार कोडित किया जाएगा?

'SPIN' is coded as 18-15-10-13 and 'BUCKET' is coded as 1-22-2-10-6-19

The pattern is:

If the letter is a consonant, then one is subtracted to the place value of the letter.

If the letter is vowel, then one is added to the place value of the letter.

W, T, H and R are consonants and their place values are 23, 20, 8 and 18 respectively. So, one is subtracted from their place values.

E, A and E are vowels and their place values are 5, 1 and 5, respectively.

So, one is added to their place values.

So, WEATHER is converted into: 22-6-2-19-7-6-17

Thus, option (a) is correct.
